contracts.description: Windows PowerShell 5.1 UTF-8/parser compatibility
Strict-mode variables do not break quality verification
agent launcher cannot silently resolve to raw cn
IDEA run configuration uses a resolved PowerShell interpreter
/model install command and Ollama pull path remain available
/deps parser and dependency policy remain available
natural result aliases such as и? recover the previous result
Git repository detection uses rev-parse top-level
incomplete docs compliance cannot pass silently
managed shell suppresses raw Continue TUI/ANSI churn
installer aborts on failed full package verification
Ollama model pull exposes progress contract
RUN-ALL Full profile log-path construction is executable under Windows PowerShell 5.1
Native stderr warnings such as Git LF/CRLF notices do not abort managed workflows under Windows PowerShell 5.1
generic acceptance repository fixture
nested Rust manifest/guard fixture
external documentation source fixture
requirements-to-code-to-tests compliance fixture
Release profile cannot qualify without live model E2E and installed runtime version match
Real model compliance -> bugfix -> deterministic tests -> review on isolated fixture
Activation and doctor reject/identify an installed runtime that does not match the candidate package
Acceptance fixture generators are repeatable, isolated, and do not fail on nonessential Git setup
Harness and live E2E outputs stay outside candidate/project roots so IDE tooling cannot treat test-results directories as source files
VERIFY-PACKAGE remains a static/package gate and does not execute runtime/native integration probes
Installed IDEA/CLI launcher starts, local commands work, and /exit terminates cleanly
Real installed shell routes natural language docs analysis, returns compliance result, supports /result and local capability help
Empty managed model output triggers deterministic recovery instead of false semantic PASS
Every test matrix contract uses the canonical required schema before StrictMode property access
Incomplete model output is finalized conservatively by the wrapper and mutating work can be promoted only after deterministic verification
Continue child process stdout and stderr are captured as UTF-8 to prevent mojibake in Windows logs
Beta reliability contract tracks wrapper-owned conservative compliance finalization rather than obsolete pre-finalizer failure text
Sandbox qualification derives the candidate version from VERSION instead of hardcoding an RC number
Compliance validation inspects only the last terminal FINAL RESULT block, so rule/tool transcript text cannot fake a COMPLIANCE MATRIX
Deterministic compliance recovery discovers docs independently of Git inventory and parses common Markdown REQ forms
Verifier assertion/regex patterns cannot use double-quoted literal PowerShell variable tokens that interpolate under StrictMode
Deterministic compliance finalization still runs when model/recovery exits non-zero, while preserving that failure as evidence and never claiming false PASS
Actual PowerShell module runtime extracts REQ-01..REQ-04 from the release fixture before any live model E2E
Qualification and live E2E failures emit persistent environment, evidence, model, recovery, requirement-extraction and fixture diagnostics
Qualification diagnostics are written outside the immutable package root and package scans ignore transient runtime directories
A canonical COMPLIANCE MATRIX immediately preceding the terminal FINAL RESULT is accepted while terminal semantic status remains authoritative
Qualification Run-Step preserves native PowerShell named-argument binding and authoritative child exit codes while keeping per-step logs
Compliance requirement extraction emits stage-by-stage diagnostics and avoids the PS5.1-sensitive TrimStart(char[]) path
PowerShell scripts must not contain unsafe double-quoted $variable: interpolation; use ${variable}: instead
Development source remains in one stable folder; Git/history replaces per-RC directory versioning until release qualification passes
Managed/headless runs show heartbeat, live activity, stall warning, visible cancellation guidance and a hard timeout instead of an unbounded silent Engineering execution state
User-facing output follows request language, separates pre-existing Git changes from files changed during the run, and treats an incomplete read-only analysis as FAIL rather than pseudo-PARTIAL
DEV.ps1 must not read an unset LASTEXITCODE after direct PowerShell script invocation under StrictMode; child scripts run in isolated powershell.exe processes with explicit native exit codes

Invoking agent from a project directory must never silently fall back to lastProject; unmarked current directories are used explicitly as project roots, and /status /result are scoped to the active project
Root-level Markdown/text/spec files are documentation; explicit edit/update/rewrite document intent routes to mutating /docs before /analysis; mutating workflows with zero changed files fail closed
Repository inventory must handle a plain non-git folder containing root main.md without invoking failing git commands; root main.md remains documentation
Repository source/docs inventory is filesystem-first and independent of Git state; root main.md and ordinary source files are discovered in plain folders and new repositories
Filesystem inventory path trimming must use a single backslash character; the previous two-character '\\' cast to [char] must never return
Managed Qwen runtime disables reasoning to avoid tool calls disappearing into thinking, and DEV install must pass a real cn headless file-edit smoke before installing

Managed Continue YAML uses only documented schema fields: reasoning false under defaultCompletionOptions; no unsupported top-level experimental block; real smoke prints stdout/stderr/config on failure
agent-init derives stack, module roots, anchored build/test commands, and safety rules from repository facts
Team mode uses separate planner, implementer, deterministic tester, and reviewer stages; stops on blocking phases; and resumes with explicit user clarification
